fusions.name: Flung Sod
fusions.desc: Throws a clod that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. 15% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 4 seconds. Its damage rises +8% per ally within 5 tiles (max +32%).

fusions.name: Leaning Crush
fusions.desc: A slow, leaning blow that deals 28 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises +8% per ally within 5 tiles (max +32%).

fusions.name: Barn Warmth
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 5 tiles, for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Huddle In
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, you regain 4 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. Your armour rises by 6%.
